name: Tails on the Rocks
source:
A recent college dropout, after working as a bartender for some years, your boss comes to you with an opportunity. A friend of his is looking for someone to take over his bar, and he has recommended you! You pack up and move across the country to the quiet seaside town like any other, except is has a majority Anthro population! Can you keep your new business afloat, and maybe find some love in some furry friends along the way?

[From [url=https://ofkeres.itch.io/tails-on-the-rocks]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
作为一名刚从大学退学的人，当了几年调酒师后，你的老板给你带来了一个机会。他的一个朋友正在寻找人来接管他的酒吧，他推荐了你！你收拾行李，穿越整个国家，像其他小镇一样搬到安静的海滨小镇，只不过这里的人口以人类为主！你能否让你的新业务持续发展，并可能在一路上遇到一些毛茸茸的朋友？

[来自[url=https://ofkeres.itch.io/tails-on-the-rocks]Itch.io[/url]]
